title: Internalizing Investment Mandates: A Neurosymbolic RL Approach to Portfolio Allocation
why_read: A niche but technically substantive paper combining reinforcement learning with symbolic constraints to keep portfolio allocation decisions compliant with investment rules.
analysis: The paper extends a neurosymbolic RL method to continuous action spaces so that a trading or allocation policy can learn to respect hard compliance constraints rather than relying on post-hoc filtering. It shows a big drop in rule violations compared to unconstrained RL and a simple reward-penalty baseline. This is a solid applied finance/RL result with clear practical motivation, since regulatory compliance is a real deployment blocker for RL in asset management. The audience is fairly narrow, mostly quant finance and constrained-RL researchers.
